notes: Sources: clementina-rom docs/memory-map.md, src/kernel/kernel.inc and BASIC's src/basic/zeropage.s, checked against the build's kernel.lbl.
Fixed addresses only. What moves with each ROM build (DIR_NAME_BUF, the end of the kernel, the start of BASIC's heap) is named in image.buildSymbols; kernel.lbl gives its value.

In pages, blocks tile each page; a block marked mapped has every byte named in locations. Locations overlap only where overlaps says so. unused marks bytes nothing reads or writes; reserved marks bytes kept for the system's growth.

Location and VIA names are the ROM's symbols; aliases are other symbols for addresses inside a location. The kernel does not define VIA_T2CL, VIA_T2CH, VIA_SR, VIA_PCR or VIA_ORA_NH; those follow the 65C22 data sheet.

regions.name: BASE_RAM
regions.description: 32 KiB of RAM, always present: zero page, stack, system pages, the kernel image and the start of BASIC's workspace.

regions.name: EXTENDED_RAM_WINDOW
regions.description: 16 KiB window into 512 KiB of banked RAM; VIA Port A PA0-PA4 select one of 32 banks.

regions.name: MIA
regions.description: MIA is selected for the whole region but sees only A0-A4: its 32 registers at $FFE0-$FFFF repeat every 32 bytes below. A mirror is the same register, side effects included; programs use $FFE0-$FFFF only.

baseRam.name: INPUT_PAGE
baseRam.description: Line input buffer, bytes free for programs and the clock snapshot; see pages.

baseRam.name: KERNEL_VARIABLES
baseRam.description: Kernel, editor and BASIC variables; see pages.

baseRam.name: IMAGE_AND_HEAP
baseRam.description: The loaded image (jump table, DIR_NAME_BUF, kernel, WozMon, BASIC), then BASIC's heap, which continues into extended RAM bank 0 up to $BFFF; see image.

image.description: The image starts at $0400 and grows up: kernel and WozMon stay below $1600 however they grow, BASIC follows them directly, and BASIC's heap runs from the end of the image (TXTTAB) to MEMSIZ. Addresses after the jump table move with each ROM build; the build's kernel.lbl gives them.

extendedRam.description: Bank 0 holds the top of BASIC's heap while BASIC runs; banks 1-31 are free for bank-aware programs, which select bank 0 again before returning to BASIC.

slots.description: Port A drives extended RAM banking; Port B, CA1/CA2 and CB1/CB2 go to the user port header. Registers repeat every 16 bytes.
Free slot on the expansion headers; a card claims it by jumpering this select line.

registers.name: VIA_ORB
registers.description: Port B data. Free: Port B goes to the user port header.

registers.name: VIA_ORA
registers.description: Port A data. PA0-PA4 select the extended RAM bank; PA5-PA7 are unused by the system.

registers.name: VIA_DDRA
registers.description: Port A direction. The kernel sets PA0-PA4 as outputs.

registers.name: VIA_T1CL
registers.description: Timer 1 counter low. The kernel's: reading it clears Timer 1's interrupt.

registers.name: VIA_T1CH
registers.description: Timer 1 counter high. The kernel's: writing it starts the timer.

registers.name: VIA_T1LL
registers.description: Timer 1 latch low. The kernel loads 6250 (VIA_T1_RELOAD).

registers.name: VIA_ACR
registers.description: Auxiliary control. The kernel owns bits 7-6 (Timer 1 free-running, PB7 output off) and keeps bits 5-0 as it finds them.

registers.name: VIA_IFR
registers.description: Interrupt flags. The kernel's IRQ handler checks bit 6 (Timer 1); other sources are free.

registers.name: VIA_IER
registers.description: Interrupt enable. The kernel enables only Timer 1, at reset and at warm start, which turn every other source off.

registers.name: VIA_ORA_NH
registers.description: Port A data without handshake. Same pins as ORA, so PA0-PA4 still select the bank.

blocks.name: BASIC
blocks.description: BASIC's variables and its CHRGET routine. A program that replaces BASIC may use them.

blocks.name: PROGRAMS
blocks.description: Free for programs (72 bytes). BASIC, WozMon and the kernel never touch them, so code called with SYS or USR can keep state here.

blocks.name: SYSTEM_SPARE
blocks.description: Spare for the system, next to the programs' block so it can be handed to programs later.

blocks.name: WOZMON
blocks.description: WozMon's variables, used only while it runs. Outside BASIC's block, so MON keeps the program.

blocks.name: KERNEL
blocks.description: Kernel variables. Programs that replace BASIC still leave them alone: the IRQ updates KJIFFY and KERN_LOAD takes its parameters in KPTR/KTMP.

locations.name: GORESTART
locations.description: JMP to BASIC's warm restart (RESTART), written at cold start.

locations.name: GOSTROUT
locations.description: JMP to STROUT, which prints the string at A/Y.

locations.name: GOAYINT
locations.description: Address of AYINT (FAC to a 16-bit integer), for machine code called through USR.

locations.name: GOGIVEAYF
locations.description: Address of GIVAYF (the 16-bit integer in A/Y to FAC), for machine code called through USR.

locations.name: USR
locations.description: JMP to the routine USR() calls. Cold start points it at the ILLEGAL QUANTITY error; POKE a routine's address into $0B-$0C.

locations.name: Z15
locations.description: msbasic's NULL count. This build has no NULL command, so nothing reads or writes it.

locations.name: POSX
locations.description: Output column BASIC tracks for TAB, SPC, POS and comma zones.

locations.name: Z17
locations.description: Line width, set to 40 at cold start. Only the CR-at-width code reads it, and this build leaves that code out (CONFIG_NO_CR).

locations.name: Z18
locations.description: Last column where a comma starts a new print zone, set to 14 at cold start. Unused for the same reason as Z17.

locations.name: LINNUM
locations.description: 16-bit integer result: a line number, or the address PEEK, POKE and SYS take.

locations.name: CHARAC
locations.description: Delimiter the scanner stops at (string literals, DATA items).

locations.name: ENDCHR
locations.description: Second delimiter for the same scans.

locations.name: EOLPNTR
locations.description: Index into the input buffer while tokenizing; subscript count while building an array.

locations.name: DIMFLG
locations.description: Nonzero while DIM creates an array.

locations.name: VALTYP
locations.description: Type of the last expression: byte 0 is $FF for a string, $00 for a number; byte 1 is $80 for an integer.

locations.name: DATAFLG
locations.description: Tokenizer flag set after DATA, so the rest of the statement is not crunched. LIST uses it for its quote state.

locations.name: SUBFLG
locations.description: Flag that forbids subscripts or integers (FN parameters, FOR variables).

locations.name: INPUTFLG
locations.description: Which statement is reading values: INPUT, GET or READ.

locations.name: CPRMASK
locations.description: Relational operator mask a comparison tests its result against. SIN and TAN reuse it as a sign flag.

locations.name: Z14
locations.description: Output-suppress flag (CTRL-O). Kept just below TEMPPT; see defines_clementina.s.

locations.name: TEMPPT
locations.description: Zero page address of the next free descriptor in TEMPST.

locations.name: LASTPT
locations.description: Pointer to the last temporary string descriptor used.

locations.name: TEMPST
locations.description: Temporary string descriptor stack: three 3-byte descriptors.

locations.name: INDEX
locations.description: General pointer (string moves, variable search, memory moves).

locations.name: DEST
locations.description: Second general pointer, mostly a move destination.

locations.name: RESULT
locations.description: Work area for floating-point multiply and divide.

locations.name: TXTTAB
locations.description: Start of the BASIC program text.

locations.name: VARTAB
locations.description: Start of simple variables, right after the program.

locations.name: ARYTAB
locations.description: Start of arrays.

locations.name: STREND
locations.description: End of arrays plus one, the bottom of free memory.

locations.name: FRETOP
locations.description: Bottom of string storage, which grows down from MEMSIZ.

locations.name: FRESPC
locations.description: Pointer to the string most recently allocated.

locations.name: MEMSIZ
locations.description: Top of BASIC memory plus one ($C000 at cold start). Lower it with POKE 63/64 and CLEAR to reserve RAM.

locations.name: CURLIN
locations.description: Line number being run; high byte $FF in direct mode.

locations.name: OLDLIN
locations.description: Line number where the program stopped, for CONT.

locations.name: OLDTEXT
locations.description: Text pointer where the program stopped, for CONT.

locations.name: Z8C
locations.description: Line number of the DATA statement being read, for READ's errors.

locations.name: DATPTR
locations.description: Address of the next DATA item READ takes.

locations.name: INPTR
locations.description: Where INPUT, GET and READ are reading from.

locations.name: VARNAM
locations.description: Name of the variable being looked up (two characters, type in bit 7).

locations.name: VARPNT
locations.description: Address of that variable's value.

locations.name: FORPNT
locations.description: Pointer to the variable a FOR, LET or INPUT assigns.

locations.name: LASTOP
locations.description: Operator table offset of the operator pending during expression evaluation.

locations.name: CPRTYP
locations.description: Relational operators (<, =, >) collected while a comparison is parsed.

locations.name: TEMP3
locations.description: Pointer to the current FN definition; also scratch.

locations.name: DSCPTR
locations.description: Pointer to the current string descriptor.

locations.name: DSCLEN
locations.description: Descriptor step during garbage collection (3 at cold start). Its second byte starts JMPADRS.

locations.name: Z52
locations.description: Garbage collection: copy of DSCLEN, the step between the descriptors being scanned. Also the low byte of JMPADRS's target.

locations.name: ARGEXTENSION
locations.description: Extra low mantissa byte of ARG. Also the high byte of JMPADRS's target.

locations.name: TEMP1
locations.description: Floating-point scratch.

locations.name: HIGHDS
locations.description: Block move: end of the destination.

locations.name: HIGHTR
locations.description: Block move: end of the source.

locations.name: TEMP2
locations.description: Floating-point scratch.

locations.name: INDX
locations.description: Floating-point scratch: an index or a temporary exponent.

locations.name: EXPON
locations.description: Decimal exponent while a number is parsed.

locations.name: LOWTR
locations.description: Low byte of a pointer used by line search and block moves; EXPSGN is its high byte.

locations.name: EXPSGN
locations.description: Sign of the decimal exponent while a number is parsed.

locations.name: FAC
locations.description: Floating-point accumulator: exponent, then four mantissa bytes.

locations.name: FACSIGN
locations.description: Sign of FAC.

locations.name: SERLEN
locations.description: Number of terms left while a polynomial series is evaluated.

locations.name: SHIFTSIGNEXT
locations.description: Sign extension while mantissas are shifted; zero after cold start.

locations.name: ARG
locations.description: Second floating-point accumulator, same layout as FAC.

locations.name: ARGSIGN
locations.description: Sign of ARG.

locations.name: STRNG1
locations.description: String pointer. Its first byte is SGNCPR (FAC and ARG signs compared), its second FACEXTENSION (FAC's rounding byte).

locations.name: STRNG2
locations.description: Second string pointer.

locations.name: CHRGET
locations.description: Routine cold start copies here: steps TXTPTR and returns the next non-space character. CHRGOT ($81) rereads the current one.

locations.name: RNDSEED
locations.description: Seed RND works from, in FAC layout. Cold start copies only its first four bytes (an msbasic quirk noted in init.s).

locations.name: XAML
locations.description: Low byte of the last opened address.

locations.name: XAMH
locations.description: High byte of the last opened address.

locations.name: STL
locations.description: Low byte of the store address.

locations.name: STH
locations.description: High byte of the store address.

locations.name: L
locations.description: Low byte of the hex value being parsed.

locations.name: H
locations.description: High byte of the hex value being parsed.

locations.name: YSAV
locations.description: Saved input index, to see whether a hex value was typed.

locations.name: MODE
locations.description: Command mode: $00 examine, $7F store, $AE block examine.

locations.name: KPTR
locations.description: General 16-bit pointer: PRSTR's string source, KERN_LOAD's destination override. CHROUT leaves it alone.

locations.name: KTMP
locations.description: Scratch: the overlay offset and address CHROUT computes. KERN_LOAD takes its run address here when it jumps; 0 means the first byte loaded.

locations.name: KCNT
locations.description: 16-bit loop counter for screen fills.

locations.name: KCHR
locations.description: CHROUT's copy of the byte being printed.

locations.name: KJIFFY
locations.description: Free-running tick counter, +1 per VIA Timer 1 IRQ (PHI2 / 6250, 192 Hz at 1.2 MHz). Measures CPU work, not wall time. Read-only for programs.

locations.name: KLOAD_BANK
locations.description: KERN_LOAD: the bank being written at $8000-$BFFF.

locations.name: KLOAD_CHUNKLEN
locations.description: KERN_LOAD: bytes read this round.

locations.name: KLOAD_SCRATCH
locations.description: KERN_LOAD: header and boundary scratch.
Spare. The kernel grows into these first, then into $E0-$E7.

blocks.name: CPU_STACK
blocks.description: 6502 hardware stack. Cold start sets S to $FF; while BASIC runs S stays at or below $FC, so pushes reach $01FC at most.

blocks.name: BASIC_LINE_STAGING
blocks.description: BASIC stages a numbered line's link and line number here, just below its input buffer.

locations.description: Staged link of a numbered line (INPUTBUFFER-4). The high byte is set to $01 before the copy; the low byte is a don't-care, and BASIC's deepest push lands on it.
Staged line number (INPUTBUFFER-2), copied from LINNUM. INPUT stores its leading comma at $01FF.

blocks.name: LINE_INPUT
blocks.description: Line input buffer, shared by BASIC and WozMon, which never run at the same time.

blocks.name: PROGRAMS
blocks.description: Free for programs (120 bytes). Nothing in the system writes here.

blocks.name: CLOCK_SNAPSHOT
blocks.description: Copy of MIA's clock written by KERN_RDTIM, in the layout MIA latches at $11078. BASIC's TI, TICKS and DELAY overwrite it too.

locations.name: INPUTBUFFER
locations.description: Typed line, up to 80 characters (INLIN_MAX), crunched in place; $00 terminator at $0250 and the tokenizer's end-of-program $00 at most at $0252. GET uses $0200-$0201.

locations.name: IN
locations.description: WozMon's line buffer.

locations.name: CLOCK_MS
locations.description: Milliseconds since MIA reset, little-endian, wraps at 2^32 (about 49.7 days).

locations.name: CLOCK_60HZ
locations.description: MIA's 60 Hz count, little-endian, wraps at 5,184,000 (24 hours). BASIC's TI reads it; KERN_SETTIM sets it.

locations.name: CLOCK_VERSION
locations.description: 1 when MIA filled the snapshot.

blocks.name: KERNEL_VARIABLES
blocks.description: Kernel and screen-editor variables, plus BASIC's style scratch (KVARS in kernel.inc).

locations.name: CURSOR_X
locations.description: Text cursor column, 0-39.

locations.name: CURSOR_Y
locations.description: Text cursor row, 0-24.

locations.name: TEXT_ATTR
locations.description: Overlay attribute for new console cells; bits 0-3 select the palette bank.

locations.name: LAST_KEY
locations.description: Debug: last byte CHRIN returned.

locations.name: EDITOR_PEN
locations.description: The screen editor's pen, set by ESC commands and copied into TEXT_ATTR at each line edit.

locations.name: KLOAD_SAVED_BANK
locations.description: KERN_LOAD: the bank mapped when it started, selected again when it returns or fails.

locations.name: DATA_BANK
locations.description: The bank BASIC's BANK statement picked for BLOAD, BRUN, BSAVE, PEEK, POKE and SYS at $8000-$BFFF; 0 at cold and warm start.

locations.name: KLOAD_RUN_BANK
locations.description: KERN_LOAD: the bank it maps at $8000-$BFFF before it jumps to the run address.

locations.name: KLOAD_MODE
locations.description: KERN_LOAD: bit 7 set when it jumps to the run address instead of returning.

locations.name: CURSOR_VISIBLE
locations.description: Nonzero while the software cursor is drawn.

locations.name: CURSOR_SAVE_CHR
locations.description: Tile under the visible cursor.

locations.name: CURSOR_SAVE_ATTR
locations.description: Attribute under the visible cursor.

locations.name: LINE_LINK
locations.description: One byte per screen row: bit 7 set when the row starts a logical line, clear when it continues the row above.

locations.name: EDIT_BUF
locations.description: The logical line the screen editor harvested on RETURN, handed to BASIC by KERN_EDITKEY.

locations.name: EDIT_LEN
locations.description: Harvested length, trailing spaces trimmed.

locations.name: EDIT_IDX
locations.description: Read index into EDIT_BUF.

locations.name: EDIT_STATE
locations.description: Nonzero while the editor is handing out a harvested line.

locations.name: EDIT_START_X
locations.description: Cursor column where the current input began, past any prompt.

locations.name: EDIT_START_Y
locations.description: Cursor row where the current input began.

locations.name: EDIT_RS
locations.description: Editor scratch: logical-line start row.

locations.name: EDIT_RE
locations.description: Editor scratch: logical-line end row.

locations.name: EDIT_CP
locations.description: Insert/delete scratch: cursor position in the logical line.

locations.name: EDIT_LL
locations.description: Insert/delete scratch: logical-line cell count.

locations.name: CURSOR_BLINK_ACTIVE
locations.description: Nonzero while CHRIN polls, so the Timer 1 IRQ may blink the cursor.

locations.name: CURSOR_BLINK_COUNT
locations.description: Timer 1 ticks left before the next cursor toggle.

locations.name: EDIT_ATTR_BUF
locations.description: Attributes of the harvested line, parallel to EDIT_BUF; BASIC copies them into styled strings.

locations.name: EDIT_MODE
locations.description: Glyph mode 0-2 the editor uses to map typed characters to alternate tiles.

locations.name: EDIT_PAINT
locations.description: Nonzero while Paint mode is on.

locations.name: EDIT_CMD_PENDING
locations.description: Nonzero between ESC and its command key.

locations.name: STYLE_SIDE_BUF
locations.description: BASIC tokenizer scratch for styled literals; TRACK, BAND, VTAKE, VGIVE and LIST reuse parts of it.

locations.name: BASIC_DEFAULT_ATTR
locations.description: Default output attribute set by COLOR, FLIPX, FLIPY and ALT.

locations.name: BASIC_STYLE_MASK
locations.description: Style override mask set by STYLE n, in overlay-attribute bit form.

locations.name: STYLE_BASE_LEN
locations.description: Tokenizer scratch: the line's length before its style sidecar.
